guide_target.label: アークザラッドⅡ（プレイステーション クラシック内蔵・日本国内版）

notes: No title-scoped source exception is used.
Set A is the directly inspectable Japanese ちょこた/みどりすたいる walkthrough family.
Set B is the independent Japanese アークザラッド２ データまとめ Wiki* family, using timing, region, boss, bounty, character, item, and guild-job pages as a composite verification set.

Sony's Japanese PlayStation Blog is authoritative for the 2018 domestic PlayStation Classic target. A directly inspected Japanese PlayStation Classic hands-on report confirms Arc I and Arc II share virtual memory-card data and conversion works.

The PlayStation Classic title has no standalone retail package; cover_url uses Sony's Arc II image from the exact PlayStation Classic announcement page rather than substituting a different retail edition cover.

mandatory: complete main story through Air Castle and final boss
complete all guild jobs, respecting expiration and prerequisite chains
hunt all practical source-documented wanted monsters and flag one-time steal/drop conflicts
recruit optional permanent characters/summons available within Arc II
cover Ruins Dungeon/Choko content and all source-verified timing-critical optional content
collect source-verified one-time/unique rewards whose opportunity can permanently disappear
optional_conversion: conversion-only secret research-lab scene early in the story
early Choko availability if Arc I Choko data was converted
full Choko awakening continuation below Ruins Dungeon B50 after the late Tokoko event
excluded: Monster Game/casino external-disc transfers and prizes
arbitrary random drops and exhaustive generic treasure collection

critical_findings: Early guild work is placed immediately after Shu joins and an explicit post-join rest. Set B supplies exact early disappearance windows; the promoted Ari no Su completion route independently corroborates clearing G#01, G#02, G#07, and G#03 in this same early block. Player guidance uses conservative ordering rather than unsupported causal wording.

The pre-White-House guild block is deliberately cleared as a conservative sweep. Set B records the exact prerequisite chains and White-House cutoffs; Chokota/Ari no Su independently document the jobs and safe early completion order. The route no longer presents one-lane causal prerequisites as two-lane facts.

G#29 and G#30 are completed during the Lieza/Gogen split. Set B records their exact expiry; an independent Japanese play diary also performs both jobs during that split, so the guide uses the shared safe placement without overstating unlock causality.

During Shu/Tosh's Romalia segment, the guide clears G#24-G#26 before the tunnel as conservative routing. Set B records G#26's short window; the route avoids presenting disputed or one-lane prerequisite claims as settled facts.

After the Chimera Research Lab reunion, G#27/G#28 and nearby bounty cleanup are performed immediately. Set B carries the exact prerequisite details; the player-facing route uses safe sequencing while independently sourcing the actions and Gravis availability.

Midgame and late guild chains are routed conservatively before major story acceleration. Where Set B alone supplies an exact prerequisite or disappearance timestamp, the guide preserves the safe order but does not state that causal rule as independently verified unless a second Japanese source supports it.
Fores becomes temporarily country-locked after the inn trigger until Ghia Temple is cleared; the mandatory temple progression is bound to both Japanese lanes.
Amigue's guild block is completed before God's Tower. Set B records the exact G#42 cutoff; the route keeps the safe placement without relying on unsupported causal wording for other Amigue jobs.

Barbarad's late guild cleanup is performed immediately after the Pyramid opening/exterior progression. Set B records G#49's exact appearance after the exterior battle; an independent Japanese completion walkthrough likewise states that 「あぶない薬」 has appeared after Pyramid progression. The broader Monji-arc lockout remains Set-B-specific, so the final audit is phrased conservatively.
G#37 is handled before Air Castle and the final cleanup also verifies God Hunter proof/GP, sealed ruins, remaining bounties, and synthesis materials.

G#23 is handled during the Romalia city assault before city completion. Set B records the exact appearance/expiry window; Chokota requires delivery to the resistance son inside Romalia city and independently states the city becomes inaccessible after its final battle, while a separate Japanese completion diary also performs the delivery during the city treasure sweep. The route therefore uses the two-lane-safe city-assault placement without overstating the exact Set-B-only timestamps.
Entering Air Castle is the final world lockout.

Choko can be recruited without conversion after Ruins Dungeon B50. The later B51-B71 awakening continuation is conversion-gated; the promoted independent Japanese Choko walkthrough corroborates the mid/late Tokoko event chronology.
In the mid Choko event, do not wipe all green slimes; collect the one-time Red Shoes and leave through the southwest route. These irreversible facts are independently corroborated.
The late Choko ruined-Tokoko event follows the north/south-tower/Andel sequence. Exact micro-actions are coarsened where the independent lane documents only the event-level progression.

Wanted monster Shamus has the first-encounter Grand Knife steal; Tianus has the first-encounter Uninyan Sword steal; Grovis's timed Sea Oil Field encounter carries Fate and conflicts with defeating Balzac first.

Palencia stall availability is disputed: Chokota says the stall is available only on initial arrival and disappears after a map change, while the Arc II Data Wiki Robe page says it opens when leaving the bar during the Elk/Poco segment. The guide therefore tells the player to check it immediately without asserting the disputed exact window.

Elk's dream has the normal-game Flame Sword opportunity; South Tower contains the missable Ice Sword; Barbarad sealed ruins contain Wind Sword; Earth Sword is available in the Yagos sealed ruin/alternate source. These feed the normal-game Light Sword synthesis.
Palencia Tower 77F is optional completion content reached by repeated 99F elevator-switch toggling.
To obtain Fate and still clear Balzac, postpone Balzac until after Grovis: independent Japanese wanted-monster sources document the conflict, and Returnless Forest remains available afterward.

The Secret Research Lab conversion event belongs before the ceremony/Yagos transition; the Ark-versus-Andel conversion event occurs after White House. They remain separate optional conversion sections.

The sealed-ruin power-unit route is completed before final lockout in the conservative order Greycine → Alaratos → Brakia → Amigue → Barbarad → Alibarsha, then Wind Sword and remaining Alibarsha bounty cleanup are completed.
Romalia city treasure must be taken before the final plaza lockout; Chokota lists the fixed city/underground loot and Set B independently documents the permanent city access loss.

Air Castle final progression is corrected to three battles after Zalbad: Kukuru alone versus the incomplete Dark Ruler, then the party versus the first form, then the party versus the second/final form. An independent Japanese playthrough explicitly calls this a three-battle sequence, and Set B documents the same structure.

For early G#03, the route does not present the Set-B-only poster/medium-success rules as independently verified causal claims. It instead uses a conservative poster check plus the independently supported no-escape job clear.
